newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Dec diesel, jet fuel from Vitol.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Dec diesel, jet fuel from Vitol.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 120,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel from Dutch trader Vitol for December 12-13 delivery, a CPC source said on Friday.

The 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil was purchased at a premium of 67.5 cents per barrel and jet fuel at a 47.5-cent-per-barrel premium, both to Singapore spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo.
The tender closed on November 13 and was valid until Friday.

In its last tender, which was awarded to Caltex Bahrain, Sri Lanka bought 160,000 barrels of 0.5-percent sulphur gas oil at a $1.77-premium, and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a $1.40-premium for November 24-25 delivery, c-and-f Colombo and Trincomalee.
